about: What a recipe's material makes its working part weigh (D565: mass comes from the parts' shapes and materials and feeds D459's rule): the part's volume_m3 times its material's density. Read by the assembler (terra_items::assembly) and the part checker (tools/items/part.ts). A material here is one an item is made in today (items.ron's stone and iron tools); a new tier adds its line with its source, a table looked up, never a recalled number.

iron.about: wrought or bloomery iron, the iron tools' heads

density_kg_m3.source: wrought iron 7750 kg/m^3 (The Engineering ToolBox, Metals and Alloys - Densities, engineeringtoolbox.com/metal-alloys-densities-d_50.html, looked up 2026-10-28), the same table's iron and steel 7850: the slag wrought iron carries makes it lighter

stone.about: knapped flint or chert, the stone tools' heads

density_kg_m3.source: flint 2.6 x 10^3 kg/m^3 (The Engineering ToolBox, Solids - Densities, engineeringtoolbox.com/density-solids-d_1265.html, looked up 2026-10-28)
